arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Rothfeld argued the government's reading of the statute is not sensible.
Mr. Kinnaird stated that children present special problems under immigration laws.
Ms. Kruger explained that Congress added a five-year durational requirement to the statute.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case asks if a child inherits a parent's permanent resident status. This status triggers eligibility for cancellation of removal. The government argues the child must hold the status independently. The child's side argues the parent's status applies to the child.

paragraphs: This case defines how children access immigration relief. It determines whether a child relies on a parent's legal status. It shapes the agency's power to remove young children from the country.
